User's full knowledge graph: takeaways + notes as nodes. Edges are

neighbor between takeaways across sources). See Root - Graph Model in the
vault for design rationale.

Create a user-authored section. A non-empty summary is hashed and an

Trigger auto-sectioning for a single source.

Returns immediately; the sectioning LLM call runs in the background.
Skips non-AV sources and AV sources whose transcript isn't ready yet.

get.description:
Return all of the user's sources plus per-type counts (book/article/
video/podcast/pdf and `all`) used by the library filter chips.

Create a source. Title is trimmed (empty rejected); a duplicate
title+type returns 409; article/video/podcast URLs are normalized.

post.description:
Fetch lightweight metadata (title/site/author/description) for a URL via
YouTube oEmbed or OpenGraph scraping. Upstream failures return 503.

put.description:
PUT-merge update: omitted fields are preserved. `tag_ids` is tri-state —
null leaves tags untouched, [] clears, a list replaces.

delete.description:
Delete a source. For `pdf` sources the stored R2 object is removed first;
child rows are handled by the DB's FK rules.

patch.description:
Move a source between todo/in_progress/reflecting/done.

The legal transition graph is enforced server-side; illegal moves return 409.
Set the long summary for a source (user-written, not AI-generated).

Store a PDF (max 50MB) for a `pdf`-type source. Replacing an existing
PDF clears highlights derived from the previous file.

AddVideoToLibraryRequest.title: AddVideoToLibraryRequest
AddVideoToLibraryRequest.description: Add an imported video to the user's library ({"video_id": ...}).

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Client-generated idempotency / resume key. If a run with this id is already in progress or recently completed, the server re-attaches and streams its buffered events instead of starting a new LLM call.

CaptureDTO.title: CaptureDTO
CaptureDTO.description:
A capture row.

Null fields are omitted from responses by the project APIRouter default.

CapturesDelta.title: CapturesDelta
CapturesDelta.description:
Mutation set for a citation's captures applied atomically alongside the
citation update. Each list is independent: omit a list to do nothing for
that operation.

ChannelDTO.title: ChannelDTO
ChannelDTO.description:
Video channel (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.). `metadata` (jsonb) intentionally
not exposed yet — add a typed sub-model when there are real fields.

CollectionDTO.title: CollectionDTO
CollectionDTO.description:
A collection row joined with its source_count.

`description` is omitted from the response when null by the project
APIRouter default. `source_count` is always present, even when zero.

CreateCaptureResponse.title: CreateCaptureResponse
CreateCaptureResponse.description:
Wraps the created capture with the optional lifecycle-transition flag.

`source_started` is true only when the create triggered a source
todo→in_progress transition; otherwise omitted from the response by the
project APIRouter default.

CreateSourceRequest.title: CreateSourceRequest
CreateSourceRequest.description:
Create a new source. Title is trimmed and validated server-side (empty
after trim is rejected); status defaults to `todo`.

CreateSourceSectionRequest.title: CreateSourceSectionRequest
CreateSourceSectionRequest.description:
Create a section under a source.

`title` is required (trimmed non-empty enforced server-side). `subtitle`
and `summary` are optional free text; ranges are optional non-negative
offsets with `range_end >= range_start` when both are present.

EnrichSourceRequest.title: EnrichSourceRequest
EnrichSourceRequest.description: A URL to fetch lightweight metadata for (oEmbed / OpenGraph).

EnrichSourceResponse.title: EnrichSourceResponse
EnrichSourceResponse.description:
Enriched metadata extracted from a URL. All fields optional — providers
rarely populate every field.

GenerateTranscriptRequest.title: GenerateTranscriptRequest
GenerateTranscriptRequest.description: Request to generate a podcast transcript.

GenerateVideoTranscriptRequest.title: GenerateVideoTranscriptRequest
GenerateVideoTranscriptRequest.description: Request to generate a video transcript.

GraphEdge.title: GraphEdge
GraphEdge.description:
An edge between two nodes.

For structural edges, `shared_citation_ids` is populated.
For semantic edges, `similarity` is populated.

GraphNode.title: GraphNode
GraphNode.description:
A node in the user's knowledge graph.

Citation-specific fields (`text`, `location`, `speaker`) are populated
only when `kind == "citation"`. Source fields apply to all three kinds.

ImportVideoRequest.title: ImportVideoRequest
ImportVideoRequest.description: Import a video by URL or bare ID ({"url": ...}).

MoveHighlightToSectionRequest.title: MoveHighlightToSectionRequest
MoveHighlightToSectionRequest.description:
Request to move a citation or capture to a section.

`section_id` may be null to unset (move back to the source's unsectioned
bucket).

NoteListDTO.title: NoteListDTO
NoteListDTO.description: List shape — drops `body`, ships a truncated `plain_text` as `preview`.

ParallelTakeaway.title: ParallelTakeaway
ParallelTakeaway.description:
A semantically-near takeaway from a different source — surfaces in the
parallels panel to seed cross-source synthesis (the takeaway → note step
on the synthesis ladder).

PdfUploadResponse.title: PdfUploadResponse
PdfUploadResponse.description: Returned after a successful PDF upload.

PdfUrlResponse.title: PdfUrlResponse
PdfUrlResponse.description:
A URL to fetch a source's stored PDF. `expires_in` is set only for
presigned URLs (seconds until expiry).

PodcastEpisodeDTO.title: PodcastEpisodeDTO
PodcastEpisodeDTO.description: Podcast episode. `metadata` (jsonb) intentionally not exposed yet.

ProcessingMetadata.title: ProcessingMetadata
ProcessingMetadata.description:
Structured processing metadata attached to every suggestion.

All fields are optional — they are added incrementally as processing
progresses, and earlier stages may not have populated later fields.

ReorderSourceSectionsRequest.title: ReorderSourceSectionsRequest
ReorderSourceSectionsRequest.description:
Ordered list of section IDs. Each ID must belong to the source; partial
sets are allowed (only the listed sections are renumbered).

RetrySuggestionRequest.title: RetrySuggestionRequest
RetrySuggestionRequest.description: Optional steering for a manual retry — guidance fed into the matcher prompt.

ShowDTO.title: ShowDTO
ShowDTO.description:
Podcast show. `metadata` (jsonb) is intentionally not exposed yet —
add a typed sub-model when there are real fields to surface.

SourceCounts.title: SourceCounts
SourceCounts.description: Type-based source counts surfaced in the list response metadata.

SourceDTO.title: SourceDTO
SourceDTO.description:
Canonical source payload returned by the CRUD + RAG endpoints.

Re-exported from `app.schemas.podcasts` for compatibility. `metadata` is the
typed `SourceMetadata` discriminated union; `coerce_metadata` parses the raw
jsonb blob against the authoritative `type` before validation.

SourceSectionResponse.title: SourceSectionResponse
SourceSectionResponse.description:
Section row returned from the list endpoint, including the
`generated_by` discriminator.

SourceStatusResponse.title: SourceStatusResponse
SourceStatusResponse.description:
Lifecycle fields returned after a status transition.

Scoped to the fields a client needs to reconcile its cache; full source
payloads come from the source CRUD endpoints.

SourceSummariesResponse.title: SourceSummariesResponse
SourceSummariesResponse.description:
Summary fields returned after an update. Scoped to what clients read
back; full source payloads come from the source CRUD endpoints.

SourcesListResponse.title: SourcesListResponse
SourcesListResponse.description:
List of sources plus type-count metadata (shape consumed by the library
page's filter chips).

StructuredCreateCaptureRequest.title: StructuredCreateCaptureRequest
StructuredCreateCaptureRequest.description:
Create-capture request body.

`text` is required and must not be empty. Cross-field rule: `citation_id`
and `section_id` cannot both be set; the handler raises 400 with
`detail: "section_id cannot be provided when citation_id is set"`.

SuggestedCapturePayload.title: SuggestedCapturePayload
SuggestedCapturePayload.description:
A single suggested capture.

Each capture is attached to at most one citation. The link is expressed via
`citation_idx` (index into the suggestion's `citations` array) for citations
that are being created alongside this capture, or `citation_id` for captures
that should attach to a pre-existing citation. Both null means a standalone
capture.

SuggestedPayloadEntities-Input.title: SuggestedPayloadEntities
SuggestedPayloadEntities-Input.description:
A suggestion that creates one or more citations and/or captures.

Captures may reference a citation in this payload by index (`citation_idx`)
or an existing citation by id (`citation_id`).

SuggestedPayloadEntities-Output.title: SuggestedPayloadEntities
SuggestedPayloadEntities-Output.description:
A suggestion that creates one or more citations and/or captures.

Captures may reference a citation in this payload by index (`citation_idx`)
or an existing citation by id (`citation_id`).

TakeawaySourceRef.title: TakeawaySourceRef
TakeawaySourceRef.description:
Slim source reference embedded on takeaway list/detail responses.

Enough to render a takeaway row ("from <title>") without an N+1 source fetch.

TranscriptData.title: TranscriptData
TranscriptData.description:
Complete transcript data structure.

Works for both podcast and video transcripts.

TranscriptLocationPayload.title: TranscriptLocationPayload
TranscriptLocationPayload.description:
Multi-anchor transcript metadata. tStartSec/tEndSec remain the source of
truth for playback UI; the utterance indices anchor the highlight in case
the transcript is re-sectioned.

TranscriptMetadata.title: TranscriptMetadata
TranscriptMetadata.description:
Metadata about the transcript.

Fields vary by source (AssemblyAI vs YouTube captions).

TranscriptUtterance.title: TranscriptUtterance
TranscriptUtterance.description:
An utterance in the transcript (speaker-labeled segment).

Note: confidence and speaker may be None for YouTube captions.

TranscriptionMetadata.title: TranscriptionMetadata
TranscriptionMetadata.description: Audio transcription result stored in processing_metadata.

TransitionSourceStatusRequest.title: TransitionSourceStatusRequest
TransitionSourceStatusRequest.description: Target lifecycle status for a source transition.

UpdateCaptureRequest.title: UpdateCaptureRequest
UpdateCaptureRequest.description:
Update-capture request body. No `section_id` field — assignment to a
section uses the sections/assign endpoint instead.

UpdateCitationRequest.title: UpdateCitationRequest
UpdateCitationRequest.description:
Patch payload. Omit a field to preserve it; pass `null` for nullable
fields (summary, speaker, context, section_id) to clear them.

UpdateSourceRequest.title: UpdateSourceRequest
UpdateSourceRequest.description:
PUT-merge update. Omitted (None) fields are left untouched.

`tag_ids` is tri-state: None leaves tags untouched, [] clears all tags, and
a populated list replaces them.

UpdateSourceSectionRequest.title: UpdateSourceSectionRequest
UpdateSourceSectionRequest.description:
PATCH a section. Omitted fields are preserved; an empty string clears an
optional text field (subtitle/summary).

`title` is required on the wire (PATCH still re-sends the title).

UpdateSourceSummariesRequest.title: UpdateSourceSummariesRequest
UpdateSourceSummariesRequest.description:
Update a source's long summary. `summary_long` is written verbatim,
so passing null clears it.

VideoDTO.title: VideoDTO
VideoDTO.description:
Video from a platform (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.). `metadata` (jsonb)
intentionally not exposed yet.
